line: Tell someone, plainly, that you're glad they exist.
paragraph: An organization in Indonesia has spent eighteen years rescuing and protecting primates. This month they carried fifty-three orangutans out of the fires burning across Borneo. The flames have been swallowing forest and peatland, turning the air thick and ruining the food the orangutans need. Some of the rescued apes have already been moved to forest preserves elsewhere on the island. The rest are receiving care. People are working through smoke and heat because these animals matter to them.

seed.summary: Forest and peatland wildfires continue to burn across the island of Borneo, endangering the air quality for both humans and wildlife—and torching the food supply for critically endangered orangutans. Fortunately, thanks to an 18-year nonprofit that focuses on primate rescue and conservation in Indonesia, a total of 53 orangutans have been rescued from the fires,
seed.sourceTitle: 53 Orangutans Rescued from Fires in Borneo, With Many Rewilded to Forest Preserves Across the Island
